row.evidence: Sophos's admin docs provision users by vendor-run directory sync ('You can synchronize users and groups from multiple sources using Microsoft Active Directory (AD) and Microsoft Entra ID'); no SCIM endpoint is documented in the admin help or the developer API reference.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: Sophos sells through quotes and partners ('Request a free, no-obligation quote'), with no public price list. The Sophos Central admin console is now titled Sophos Fusion in the docs. Users and groups are brought in by Sophos-run directory synchronization from on-prem AD (installer), Microsoft Entra ID (Azure app registration) and Google Directory, not SCIM; the docs sitemap (1,087 pages) and developer API reference contain no SCIM pages. Federated sign-in for admins and users supports Microsoft Entra ID, OpenID Connect and Microsoft AD FS; no plan gate is stated. The Common API (/common/v1, OAuth client-credentials service principal) has directory user, group, admin and role endpoints, plus an Audit Events API. Status none (rule 3/none-by-absence: directory sync is not SCIM).

auth.notes: Service-principal credentials exchanged for a bearer token; X-Tenant-ID header required.

endpoints.purpose: Create tenant admin from a directory user
Assign a role to an admin

rate_limits.text: 10 calls/second (recommended), 100 calls/minute enforced with bursts to 300, 1000/hour recommended, 200,000/day enforced; per credentials, account and IP.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/sophos-central/ and /sophos/ return 404; OIDC federated sign-in may be usable with Okta but is not documented by name.

entra.notes: Sophos-run sync via an Azure app registration; no Entra gallery tutorial found (sophos-central tutorials 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Vendor-run directory sync from on-prem Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Directory
